content: Hey sweetie, how was your day? I kept thinking about you and hoping you're doing well.
Hi! My day was alright, but it's always better when I hear from you. How are you and Emma?
Emma's good, thank you for asking. She keeps asking when she'll get to meet you! I told her you're very special to me.
Aww, that's so sweet. I'd love to meet her too someday. She's lucky to have a dad who cares so much.
That means a lot. Honestly, you make me feel like I can handle anything life throws at me. I don't say it enough, but thank you for always being there for me.
Of course, you're always so supportive of me too. I really value what we have.
It's rare to find someone who understands and cares the way you do. There's something I wanted to talk to you about, and it's a bit embarrassing.
You can tell me anything. I hope everything is okay?

Everything is fine with us, but Emma's school sent an unexpected notice today. Her tuition and registration fees are due immediately, and with some recent delays in my business payments, I'm a bit stuck. I hate asking, but could you help us out this time? You'd really be helping Emma continue her studies.
Oh, I'm so sorry you're dealing with that stress. How much do you need?
Thank you for understanding, darling. The total is $1,200, which covers everything for this term. If you could send it today, I can pay the school on time. Is that possible?
I'll try to help. What's the best way to get the money to you?
You're a lifesaver. I use Zelle for business, so if you could send it to emmafutureedu@gmail.com, it'll go straight to the school account. Let me know if you need help with the process.
Okay, I haven't used Zelle much before. Can you walk me through it?

Absolutely, it's very safe and easy. All you need to do is open your banking app, select Zelle, and enter that email. If there's any issue or if the bank calls to confirm, just say you're sending money to Emma's school. It's routine security. Let me know if you get stuck anywhere.
Alright, I'm logging in now. Should I send a note or just the amount?
Just the amount is fine, but if you want, you can write 'Emma's tuition' in the note. Thank you so much for doing this. You're truly part of our family.
It's sending now. Please let me know as soon as you get it.
I will, sweetheart. You have no idea how much this means to me and Emma. You're showing what love really is.
I just want to help. I know you'd do the same for me.
Absolutely, always. I promise you, this is the last time I'll ever have to ask. You're the most important person to us.
